title: The same law in a black hole and a stock market
description: An interactive essay: the Marchenko–Pastur law, written down in 1967 for neither, governs the noise in a correlation matrix and the radiation of an evaporating black hole.

title: One year per year
description: An interactive essay on alpha discovery when hypotheses are free and the evidence that judges them still arrives at the speed of the calendar.

title: Nobody did it
description: An interactive essay on deterrence when delegating decisions to machines produces acts with no author.

title: Why broken things make invariants
description: An interactive essay on how gauge theory and Floer theory build invariants from the ways their solutions break.

title: Who vouches for a machine?
description: An interactive essay on the trust layer machine commerce still lacks: a court, a ledger, an underwriter, and the prices that would feed them.

title: Two ways for a theory to fail
description: An interactive essay on geometric and informational singularities, from Norton’s dome to the island formula.

title: The balance point of a hexagon
description: An interactive essay on slope stability, Kähler–Einstein metrics, and six arrows that balance on average and still lean.

title: Nothing condenses alone
description: An interactive essay on Higgs transitions in compact Calabi–Yau threefolds, where gravity turns local symmetries into shared constraints.

title: A page for every paper
description: The 39-paper collection now has individual abstract pages, citation downloads, and archive links. Thirty-three papers also have verified PDF copies hosted here.

title: Mirror symmetry for conifold relations
description: The current public manuscript is dated 25 October 2026. The paper page links its abstract, PDF, source, and archived version.
